detail: Marius, a newcomer to Roman politics, wins the consulship and takes over the war in Africa. He fills his legions with landless volunteers, soldiers who look to their general for land and pay.
label: 107 BCE
note: Added for context; not from the reading notes.
title: Marius becomes consul
tldr: Marius fills his legions with landless volunteers, who look to their general, not the state, for land and pay.
